negative_reviews.author: Rodolfo Prado Bores
negative_reviews.text:
The meals were good, but we were overcharged.
One of my friends ordered a drink and a side dish besides her main, so they informed us about their  £18 Lunch Deal option (side dish + main + drink). We weren't interested since it wasn't as cheap as it seemed. But when we got the bill we noticed that they charged us our orders plus those £18! Not to mention that the bill was already confusing; it didn't specify the price of my meal, for instance.

negative_reviews.author: Oscar Anderson
negative_reviews.text: The food was delicious but I was uncomfortable as after I had finished ordering he suggested that if he needed to make it halal and assumed i had this dietary restriction based on the colour of my skin.
